summary: The HTTP host adapter serves Memory over MCP and implements a fail-closed local or external-OAuth resource-server boundary.
worksToday: Serves Memory tools through MCP Streamable HTTP.
Validates externally issued JWT signature, issuer, audience, expiry, and required scopes.
limitations: Memory is not an OAuth authorization server and supplies no login, DCR, consent, token, or refresh endpoint.
Only deterministic JWKS/JWT fixtures were exercised.
No authenticated clean-install or real-consumer task receipt exists.
supportedEnvironments: Windows source build; portable Rust implementation
installation: Build from source with cargo build -p elegy-memory-mcp --bin elegy-memory-mcp-http.
invocation: Set ELEGY_MCP_AUTH_MODE and the mode-specific documented variables, then run elegy-memory-mcp-http.

evidence.summary: Local guard, external JWT validation, challenge, endpoint isolation, and Memory source tests passed.
The HTTP binary compiled as part of the workspace suite.
